notes: Access: direct HTTP (Magento 2 GraphQL) plus Playwright render (SPA storefront). Checked full main-nav category tree (see bs18 notes for the full list) and the ~3760-URL sitemap grepped case-insensitively for clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line/discontinued - zero matches anywhere. The only markdown-style page in the entire taxonomy is a single top-level category named 'SALE' (category id 51, url /en-uae/sale.html), which IS a genuine live PLP: rendered it with Playwright and captured the underlying Klevu categoryPath merchandising call (eucs26v2.ksearchnet.com/cs/v2/search, searchedTerm='*', meta.totalResultsFound=36), cross-validated exactly by Magento GraphQL products(filter:{category_id:51}).total_count=36 - both agree at 36. Applied the Sale-vs-Clearance test from the brief: breadcrumb reads 'HOME > SALE' (not Clearance/Outlet), the category's CMS banner image alt-text is literally '50% OFF', the meta_title is 'Buy Luxury furniture on SALE in Dubai and UAE', and every product row on the rendered page shows a struck-through original price next to a discounted price (e.g. Lakozy Outdoor Dining Table 6,650 vs 9,500; Collings Dining Chair 775 vs 1,550 - a straight percent-off pattern, discounts vary by item ~30-50%). Nowhere on the page, in its breadcrumb, meta title/description, or CMS copy does the site use clearance/outlet/final/last-chance/end-of-line language - this reads as a standard percent-off promotional Sale section of the catalogue, not a permanent-markdown/outlet listing, so per the brief's explicit instruction ('a generic temporary promotional sale... percent-off campaign with no permanence signal - do not include it as Clearance') it is excluded rather than recorded as Clearance. This was not a borderline call - there is no clearance/outlet signal anywhere to make it ambiguous - so no MANUAL REVIEW flag was used either. No Arabic-language clearance term found in nav. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance/Outlet PLP exists on this site; the one markdown-style page found (Sale, 36 products) is a generic promotional Sale, correctly out of scope per the brief.
